lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Good morning! You look like you didn't sleep at all.
lines.zh: 早上好！你看起来一夜没睡。

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I didn't. My neighbor practiced the drums until three.
lines.zh: 我确实没睡。邻居练鼓练到凌晨三点。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Then you need a large coffee, and maybe a nap.
lines.zh: 那你需要一大杯咖啡，也许还要小睡一会儿。

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Just the coffee, please. I have a meeting at nine.
lines.zh: 只要咖啡就好。我九点有个会。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Sure thing. Would you like milk or sugar?
lines.zh: 没问题。要加奶或者糖吗？

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Black is fine. Wait, is that my umbrella by the door?
lines.zh: 黑咖啡就行。等等，门边那把是我的伞吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I think someone left it here yesterday.
lines.zh: 我想是昨天有人落在这儿的。

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: It is mine! I have been looking for it all week.
lines.zh: 就是我的！我找了一整个星期。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Then today is your lucky day. That will be three dollars.
lines.zh: 那今天是你的幸运日。一共三美元。

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Keep the change. And thanks for taking care of my umbrella.
lines.zh: 不用找了。谢谢你帮我保管雨伞。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Anytime. Try not to lose it again.
